bahuvrīhi compound kavitva-amṛta-sāgara; epithet of the goddess

items.question: In what dual forms does the goddess embody the nectar of poetry?
premises: The goddess is characterized as the essence of poetry's nectar.
The goddess is characterized as the ocean of poetry's nectar.
Both epithets identify her with the source and substance of poetic inspiration.
items.inference: The goddess embodies poetic nectar both as its concentrated essence and as its boundless ocean.
items.plain_english: And she is the essence of the nectar of poetry, and the ocean of the nectar of poetry.
